preference_text:
--- Refinement ---
Carry the three existing screens forward unchanged, except: on the
project view, reorder to agent rows first, then the cost strip, then
the round tree (heading, lines, legend). Keep all existing sample
content exactly as it is; do not rewrite it. Add three screens and two
insets in the same register — dark, dense, one accent, no decoration,
Inter for UI text, JetBrains Mono for paths, files, model names and
figures. Every screen sits under the same status bar and nav.

SCREEN 4 — Directory picker (nav: Project active; status bar shows no
directory yet, so its path slot is empty). One column, max 720px. A
mono text input holding "/Users/rc/projects" with a neutral outline
"Up" button at its right end. Below, a list of directories, one per
line in mono, 28px rows, hover shows a 1px rule: "bws4", "spec4",
"notes", "archive". Below the list, one row: a neutral outline
"Create folder" button and, beside it, a mono text input placeholder
"new-folder". At the bottom, "Select this directory" as the one filled
green button, right-aligned.

SCREEN 5 — Setup wizard, step 2 of 3, the model step (nav: Settings
active). Draw step 2 rather than step 1 so the Effort control is
visible; step 1 is the same panel with a provider select and key
field instead. One
column, max 720px. A compact three-step stepper as plain text with a
1px rule: "Provider · Model · Search", the second marked like the
active nav item. Title, one line: "Default model". One dimmed line:
"Connected to Anthropic". A panel with: Model select showing
"claude-sonnet-5"; beside it, narrower, an Effort select showing
"default"; under the pair one dimmed line "Effort applies to every
agent that uses the default; each agent's gate can override it".
Button row: "Back" neutral outline at left; "Continue" as the one
filled green button at right.

SCREEN 6 — Designer wizard, Preferences step (nav: Project active;
pill bar as on the chat frame with Designer active). The same compact
stepper: "No-UI check · Start / Resume · Preferences · Screenshots ·
Generate · Preview", Preferences active. One line of instruction:
"Describe the visual direction; the vision and feature specs are
already in context." A textarea, six lines, containing two lines of
sample preference text in the default text colour. Button row: "Back"
neutral outline at left, "Next" filled green at right. Below, as the
run cost strip on the chat frame, the same three-line strip with
Designer figures.

INSET A — Gate panel, drawn on the chat frame screen where the first
message would be (or as a standalone inset if easier). A 1px-bordered
panel, full content width: first line in mono, "Model for
Brainstormer: claude-sonnet-5 · default"; second line a button row —
"Use default" filled green, "Pick a model" neutral outline. Then the
same panel in its expanded state: the provider select, key field with
its dimmed line, the model select from the setup wizard, and beside
the model select a narrower "Effort" select showing "high" (its
options: default, low, medium, high, xhigh, max), with "Use this
model" filled green and "Cancel" neutral outline. The status bar on
this screen reads "claude-sonnet-5 · high" in the model slot.

INSET B — Project-mode question, standalone inset, max 560px. Title in
sentence case: "Is there an existing project here?" Two lines of
dimmed text: "Spec4 found files in this directory. Existing means
CodeScanner reads them first; new means it starts from the vision."
One row of two buttons: "Existing project" filled green, "New project"
neutral outline.

No new colours, no icons, no glyph arrows, no alerts; facts are dimmed
lines. The attached screenshots show the current screens so you can
see which controls exist. Reproduce the function, not the styling.
